sn56.29:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave catunnam ariyasaccānam atthi ariyasaccam pariññeyyaṃ || atthi ariyasaccam pahātabbaṃ || atthi ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ || atthi ariyasaccam bhāvetabbaṃ || ||
sn56.29:2.2: Dukkham bhikkhave ariyasaccam pariññeyyaṃ || dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccam pahātabbaṃ || dukkhanirodham ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭīpadā ariyasaccam bhāvetabbaṃ || || 6.
sn56.29:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
